statement: Which of these is equal to 47 x 53 x 61?

choices.misconception: I multiplied 2491 by 60 and forgot to add the last 2491 needed to make 61 lots.
I multiplied 2491 by 6 instead of 60 and then added 2491, losing a place value.
I worked out 47 x 53 as 2500 + 9 = 2509 instead of 2500 - 9, then multiplied by 61.
I rounded 47 x 53 to 50 x 50 = 2500 and multiplied that by 61.

hints: You may not need to multiply at all: look at the last digits.
Eliminate choices with cheap checks: a product of odd numbers is odd, its last digit comes only from the last digits of the factors, and its size is close to 50 x 50 x 60.
The last digit is the last digit of 7 x 3 x 1, which is 1. Only one choice ends in 1.

solutions.reliable: Multiply carefully: 47 x 53 = 2491 (it is 50 x 50 - 3 x 3), and 2491 x 61 = 2491 x 60 + 2491 = 149,460 + 2491 = 151,951. The transferable idea: before grinding through a long calculation, check whether a quick test like the last digit already picks out the answer.
solutions.elegant: The last digit of the product is the last digit of 7 x 3 x 1 = 21, which is 1. Of the choices, only 151,951 ends in 1, so no long multiplication is needed. Its size also fits the estimate 50 x 50 x 60 = 150,000.

whyOnTest: Kangaroo rewards checking choices against cheap facts like parity, last digit and size before doing long arithmetic.
author: Devansh Sanghavi
